description_en: Queries the hot parameter rules of an application by calling the ListHotParamRulesOfApp operation
description_zh: 调用ListHotParamRulesOfApp接口获取应用热点规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi list-hot-param-rules-of-app --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHotParamRulesOfApp

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the App ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
